name: R90 · a position belongs to a thing while it is STILL: R89's chase dropped when the thing leaves the view still moving (chase_stop_v 0.05), the things reduction never attending a young cluster (things_skip_movers), and a stop that ends on a confirmed chase (--stop-on-chase)
hint: The lever after the operator's eye on R89 (2026-09-28): 'the robot measured the train passing while standing, then proceeded to the location where the train was during the measurement and pecked there.' Three parts, one principle -- a position belongs to a thing while it is still: a chase that ends with the thing still moving is DROPPED (not remembered); the things reduction never attends a young cluster (a passing thing's smear is not a thing); a stop ENDS when a chase is confirmed, so the walker follows. Control: R84. WATCH: no walk to where the train was; a stop cut short when the train passes, the duck turning after it; the yellow arrow (M) is the chase.
